quant: UD-Q4_K_M (MoE Q4_K experts, lm_head Q6_K t16)
purpose: Settle GPU-bound vs host-bound for the CURRENT production block verify (verify_target_block rows=4, bulk) with the landed rowtile lm-head. Supersedes the 2026-06-28 '~52% host-dispatch-bound' claim, which was the OLD serial per-row route.
method: Differential per-block cost: wall via clean perf_counter over the block-verify loop (no profiler), GPU via rocprofv3 --kernel-trace DurationNs sum; both differenced over N=8 vs N=32 block-verifies to cancel prefill/context fixed cost. Standalone async-issue probe confirms per-kernel-launch host dispatch ~12 us.

interpretation.graph_capture_lever: REFUTED. Only 10.2% host is exposed; best case (eliminate all exposed host) caps verify at 38.1 ms = ~+11% (~1.22x absolute ceiling) and is unreachable. ROCm 7.x hipGraphLaunch re-pays per-node overhead at ~1000-node DAGs (M12.1 2026-05-22). The GDN-corruption fix that graph capture required would be wasted effort.
interpretation.c_loop_or_memoize_lever: REFUTED. Same <=10% host ceiling; per-launch dispatch is only ~12 us.
interpretation.dp4a_lever: REFUTED on correctness. Cuts GPU kernel time but ja greedy top-1 0.700 < 0.90 gate even MoE-selected (scratchpad/dp4a-verify-full.json).
interpretation.moe_grouping_lever: REFUTED. Per-row disjoint-weight (top-8 of 256), L2-served; all-distinct only 1.40-1.54x of all-same.
interpretation.lm_head_rowtile: LANDED, the only shared-weight GPU amortization (all rows read the same head). Raised GGUF MTP 1.0534x -> 1.1134x bit-exact.
interpretation.conclusion: hipEngine GGUF block verify is at its exact-precision GPU-compute ceiling. Residual gap to llama 1.342x is purely llama's pipeline-wide dp4a/q8_1 precision tradeoff, which fails hipEngine's ja correctness gate.

context_vs_llama.note: hipEngine beats llama on AR and on precision (exact, passes ja gate llama's dp4a recipe fails); reaches 90.3% of llama's MTP tok/s at exact precision.
